Meilisearch v1.55.1 introduces important security fixes. Upgrading from v1.55.0 and earlier is recommended for all users.

See the [release notes for Meilisearch v1.56.1](https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/releases/tag/v1.56.1) for details.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/compare/v1.55.0...v1.55.1

### ✨ Enhancement

- Introduce `sampledCount` to compute the facet distribution by @Kerollmops in https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/pull/6649
    It is a new sorting option when retrieving the facet distribution. It is less precise than by `count` but provides a rough estimate of the facet distribution. Note that the count of documents for each facet is exhaustive but the list of facets is not and some facets that would have been listed by using the by `count` method can be ignored/skipped.

- Field values may now be strings and booleans in addition to numbers. Numbers serialize exactly as before, so existing files read back unchanged. Strings are written in double quotes with escaping and booleans as `true`/`false`.
- `FieldQuery` accepts string right-hand sides. Booleans only compare equal to booleans, and ordering comparisons skip values of a different kind.

**New installations** generate and persist identity with `prepare-native-config`, then explicitly bootstrap a never-used database. Keep the initialization image receipt when you later change the workload image. Authority and identity mismatches fail closed. ## 2.3.1 — negotiate the legacy protocol version instead of hard-rejecting

The legacy `initialize` path no longer returns `-32602 "Unsupported protocol
version"` when the client names a revision other than `2025-06-18`. Per the MCP
spec's version negotiation, the proxy now always answers with the revision it
supports (`2025-06-18`) and lets the client decide whether to proceed. It still
never echoes a revision it does not implement.
